sessions.name: B
sessions.reply:
I added a `count` command to fieldnotes, and the project checks pass.

- **Command:** `python -m fieldnotes.cli count` prints the number of notes. I changed `fieldnotes/cli.py` and updated the usage text to `add TEXT | list | count`.
- **Tests:** I added `tests/test_cli.py` with two tests, one for an empty store (prints `0`) and one after two adds (prints `2`).
- **Checks:** I ran `python tools/check.py --jobs 1` with `NOTES_HOME` set to a temp directory. All 3 tests ran and passed, the script exited cleanly, and it printed no line-length violations. I used `--jobs 1` because you said the parallel runner makes your disk encryption thrash.

`check.py` needs `NOTES_HOME` set. Without it, the script fails with a `KeyError`.
